response: Saved Views is available today for all customers on paid plans. If you've ever rebuilt the same filters, sort order, and grouping every time you open a project, this feature removes that repetition. Create a custom view once—filtered by assignee, status, priority, or due date—and save it for instant access whenever you need it. Each user can save up to 50 views, so you can keep separate setups for sprints, client work, personal priorities, or anything else your workflow requires. Views can also be shared with your team, making it easy to align everyone around the same filtered perspective on a project, whether that's a weekly status view or a backlog grouped by owner. Shared views update automatically as underlying data changes, so everyone always sees current information without extra setup. Saved Views is included in all paid plans at no additional cost, giving your whole team a faster, more consistent way to work. Open any list and select Save view to get started.
